details:
The mod_h2 Apache httpd module implements the HTTP2 protocol (h2+h2c) on top of libnghttp2 for httpd 2.4 servers.  

Security Fix(es):  

  * httpd: Apache HTTP Server: mod_http2 use-after-free / wild write via shared session->bbtmp re-entrancy (CVE-2026-57941)
  * httpd:2.4/mod_http2: mod_http2: httpd: Remote code execution in mod_http2 (CVE-2026-119618)


For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
